gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems, its tall lowercase like stamped metal type. Hind Guntur is the open counterweight to Capture It, whose letters sit nearly sealed shut.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hind-madurai: Wide-open s curves and lowercase that fills the line like capitals make this sans approachable. Hind Madurai gives the towering, nearly sealed Capture It somewhere to rest, so the page moves from tight to open.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary in feel, Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase up toward the ascenders and leaves each a ajar beside Capture It. Long paragraphs would hum along without any thinning strokes to snag the eye.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hind-siliguri: Capture It stacks towering, nearly sealed letters into a block of urban command. But Hind Siliguri, a sans with gently gapped rounds and a flat gray hum, carries the text.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hind-vadodara: A towering x-height gives Capture It its urban command, with letters packed nearly sealed. Hind Vadodara is the opposite, a sans with spacious gaps in its rounds and tall, open-looking bowls.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-huninn: A towering x-height makes Capture It feel urban and commanding. Huninn, a sans-serif whose lowercase rises close to cap height, can sit a couple of sizes below the heading and still hold its own.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight draws modern lines like bent tubing, with short ascenders barely above the lowercase. Inter Tight looks right a couple of sizes below Capture It, whose towering letters sit nearly sealed.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-karla: Stocky and friendly, with a gaping c opening and a tall middle band, this sans-serif reads modern. Karla keeps long paragraphs feeling approachable, a loose counterweight to the nearly sealed Capture It.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-kedebideri: Capture It is urban and commanding, its letters nearly sealed. Kedebideri, a sans-serif with a skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters, opens up what the heading keeps tightly shut.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-khula: Khula keeps a tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open, modern and unshowy. But Capture It does the loud work, towering and nearly sealed, while Khula carries the reading.
